title: Single-Storey Garden Pool Villas, Na Muang
blurb: A gated community of single-storey garden villas in the quieter, greener Na Muang hills of Koh Samui — practical 2- and 3-bedroom homes, from ฿2,990,000 for the entry 2-bedroom unit without a pool, with private-pool villas from ฿4,500,000. Warm tropical-minimalist interiors, covered parking and private gated plots make it an easy entry into island ownership, whether for full-time living or holiday rental. Minutes from Lamai, schools and the ferry.
detail:
WARM TROPICAL MINIMALISM IN THE NA MUANG HILLS
A gated community of single-storey garden villas in the calmer, greener Na Muang area of Koh Samui — built around privacy, simplicity and easy everyday living, away from the busy tourist zones yet minutes from the island's main ring road. Each home sits on its own fenced plot with a private gate, covered parking and a garden-view outlook, within a landscaped setting with 24-hour CCTV and a secured entrance.

OPEN SINGLE-STOREY LIVING
Every villa follows an easy single-storey layout, where living areas, bedrooms, pool, terrace and garden stay naturally connected — no stairs, no heavy resort structure. Large glass openings draw light through the home and open onto the private pool. Interiors are warm tropical minimalism: soft neutral tones, natural wood, clean walls and warm lighting, comfortable for full-time living and simple to maintain.

THE VILLAS
Practical 2- and 3-bedroom homes. Unit N2 is the only villa sold without a pool; every other unit either comes with a private pool built in or can be built with one as an optional extra for ฿720,000 (a standard 3×6 m pool). Where two built-up figures are shown, the pool layout is the larger; the base price is the same either way.

2-Bedroom (2 bath)
Unit N2 — no pool · 136 m² built-up · 176 m² land — from ฿2,990,000 · ready to view
Units N21 & N23 — private pool included · 136 m² built-up · 177 m² land — ฿4,500,000 · already built, handover within 3 months of signing
Unit N30 — 145–159 m² built-up · 215 m² land — ฿6,000,000 · optional pool +฿720,000
Unit N28 — 142–163 m² built-up · 217 m² land — ฿6,200,000 · optional pool +฿720,000

3-Bedroom (3 bath)
Unit N35 — 173–204 m² built-up · 284 m² land — ฿7,500,000 · optional pool +฿720,000
Unit N34 — 183–217 m² built-up · 308 m² land — ฿7,700,000 · optional pool +฿720,000
Unit N26 — 180–216 m² built-up · 305 m² land — ฿8,000,000 · optional pool +฿720,000

A free furniture package is offered on purchases made by November 2026.

INCLUDED & PROTECTED
Defined specifications and core systems come as standard — water heater and pump, utility meters and air-conditioning provisions — backed by a 5-year structural warranty and 1-year cover on water and electrical equipment. A staged payment plan runs from reservation to handover, with selected upgrades and furniture packages available by unit.

OWNERSHIP COSTS
Freehold: land is transferred at the local Land Office; transfer tax and fees run to roughly 5.5% of the purchase price (in most cases under ฿100,000), typically split evenly between buyer and seller.
Leasehold: the lease is registered at the Land Office for a fee of about 1.1% of the lease value (in most cases under ฿40,000), also typically split evenly.

KEY FACTS
Location: Na Muang, Koh Samui — a quieter, greener setting near the ring road
Single-storey villas · private gate, fence & covered parking · garden views
Unit N2 ready to view now (no pool); N21 & N23 already built and handing over within 3 months of signing; remaining units off-plan, approx. 12 months to completion
15 min to Lamai Beach & Raja Ferry Pier · 20 min to Koh Samui Hospital · 4 min to Greenacre International School
Ownership structured freehold or leasehold
Prices from ฿2,990,000 (no pool) or ฿4,500,000 (with pool); availability and exact figures per unit confirmed on request
